name: Shattered Worlds
source:
Trailer: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7-wbe-XUkRA
Teaser for Chapter 5: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Adh_JoG677A

You died. That was the easy part.
Wake in a world that exists in two states at once, a golden lie and a crimson truth. Cross between them and it costs you your own memories. Three men make the toll worth paying. Decide who is worth what you are losing.
Shattered Worlds is a choice-heavy BL / yaoi visual novel: timed choices where hesitation is tracked, earnable true endings, full voice acting, and a memory-cost mechanic that makes every crossing hurt.
translation:
预告片：https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7-wbe-XUkRA第5章预告片：https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Adh_JoG677A你死了。这是最简单的部分。
在一个同时存在两种状态的世界中醒来：金色的谎言和猩红的真相。跨越它们会损失你自己的记忆。三个人的付出是值得的。决定谁值得你失去什么。
《破碎的世界》是一款选择较多的BL / yaoi视觉小说：追踪犹豫的定时选择、可赚取的真实结局、完整的配音以及让每次穿越都会受到伤害的记忆消耗机制。
